_comment: Household OS config (non-budget). budget.json holds money targets; this file holds house-ops, energy, and family-calendar settings. Copy to config/household.json and edit; the real file is gitignored.
_tz_note: IANA zone for all lanes (e.g. America/Chicago). Empty: the system timezone is used.
_meal_note: Directory containing meal_plan_*.md files (### numbered dinner headings). Empty: the briefs just omit the dinner line.

brief._note: How many open tasks the morning message shows.

family_events._calendar_note: Target calendar for auto-filed family events. If your Google account has a family group, the built-in Family calendar is ideal: it is auto-shared with every member. Find ids with: gog -a you@gmail.com calendar calendars -p. Empty: the scanner runs propose-only (confirm tasks, no calendar writes).
family_events._deny_note: Excluded in the Gmail query itself (-from:). calendar-notification@google.com is load-bearing: without it the scanner would re-ingest its own calendar invite notifications.
family_events._max_note: Cap on new messages scanned per 30-min run. Bounds the LLM extraction calls; anything past the cap is picked up next run.

energy._rate_note: Your blended residential rate, used only for rough cost lines. Refine from an actual bill.

peak._note: Time-of-use peak window. A shiftable plug drawing over nudge_watts in that window gets one Telegram nudge per day. Nothing is ever switched automatically.

energy._roles: unassigned = log only. freezer = power-loss alerts that bypass quiet hours. shiftable = peak-window nudges. monitor = log only, never alerts. Rename the plugs to what they feed when assigning roles. The example IPs are RFC 5737 documentation addresses; use your plugs' real LAN IPs.

_bot_note: Name the bot uses when greeting approved chats. Empty: a generic greeting.

serve._note: Dashboard bind address. 127.0.0.1 = this machine only (default); 0.0.0.0 = LAN/VPN exposure, opt-in and unauthenticated, never expose to the internet.

money._source_note: One of: simplefin (SimpleFIN Bridge, ~$15/yr, run scripts/pull_simplefin.py --claim <setup-token> once), csv (free, bank-export file, see scripts/pull_csv.py docstring), monarch (reference client via client_dir). Empty: the money lane is skipped cleanly.
money._client_note: monarch source only: directory of the finance client module (see scripts/pull.py docstring).
money._rules_note: simplefin/csv sources carry no categories; these substring rules (matched against the transaction description, first hit wins) feed the engine's buckets. The employer->Paychecks rule is load-bearing for payday detection; grocery rules are load-bearing for the essentials reservation. Refine over the first week.

rails._note: Monthly report-only price watch across grocery rails (scripts/rail_check.py). Needs an LLM CLI with web tools (default: Claude CLI; override via rails.llm_cmd). Prices are search-derived directionals with a per-item confidence tag; the digest says so. Empty basket or fewer than 2 rails: the lane stays off.
